name: What factors should I consider when choosing a new bathtub for my luxury bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a new bathtub for my luxury bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a new bathtub for your luxury bathroom renovation, consider factors such as the type of tub (freestanding, alcove, jetted), its material (acrylic, cast iron, solid surface), size, and desired features like hydrotherapy. Your choice should align with your aesthetic preferences, the available space, and your vision for a spa-inspired retreat. As part of our design-build process, we help homeowners navigate these decisions, ensuring the selected bathtub enhances functionality, beauty, and value. We assess the structural requirements and plumbing compatibility to ensure a seamless integration into your new bathroom design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider tub type, material, size, and features to align with your aesthetic and functional needs for a spa-inspired bathroom. AKN Design Group assists in integrating this choice into your overall design.
